articles.title: The surprising truth about who the loneliest generations are
articles.summary: Conversations around it often focus on the elderly. But by some measures, people in their 20s are the loneliest group in Britain
articles.body:
"I wasn't alone all the time, but […] I was a bit of an outsider," he remembers.

As he headed home that night, the streets were full of Halloween partygoers in monster and cat costumes. "I walked past people turning up to friends' houses, people running into shops to buy beer.

"All the pubs were full. It just [felt] like a different world that you're not part of. And you feel like you can never be part of it."

That night, he felt like the only person experiencing serious loneliness. In fact, it is becoming a defining feature of his generation.

Conversations around social isolation tend to focus on the elderly, especially around Christmas. But by some measures, people in their 20s are the loneliest group in Britain.

According to Office for National Statistics (ONS) research published last month, 33% of Britons aged 16 to 29 reported feeling lonely "often, always or some of the time" - the highest of all age groups (17% of over-70s said the same thing).

This year, the World Health Organization reviewed various studies published across the world and found that young adults and adolescents report the highest levels of loneliness too.

The data is complex, and there are indications that, in some countries, among the very oldest group (over-85s), loneliness shoots up and could match that of 18-to-30s. But analysts say that in most research, young adults shine through as a particularly isolated group.

"Adults between 18 and 24 are the most lonely - followed by older people," says Prof Andrea Wigfield, director of the Centre for Loneliness Studies at Sheffield Hallam University. "It's a growing problem."

But why has this happened - and is there a solution?

Increasingly, experts say the modern world is to blame. Many twenty-somethings live in house-shares where they do not know or like their housemates. Work increasingly is done from home and friends are often spoken to on social media.

It is not all bleak. Thanks to the internet, young adults enjoy access to friendships from all over the world. But broadly speaking, experts say, the image of gregarious twenty-something life presented in sitcoms like Friends needs urgent correction.

"We tend to romanticise young adulthood as a carefree time - when it's usually the most miserable time in people's lives," says Prof Richard Weissbourd, a lecturer in education at Harvard University.

In some ways, early adulthood has always been a time of instability. Young adults tend to leave their childhood home and move around. Friends depart, and family ties weaken. These transitory life events can, for some, lead to intense loneliness.

"A big problem is the scattering - everybody you ever knew now lives in a million different places," says Dr Meg Jay, a clinical psychologist and author of The Twenty-Something Treatment.

This "scattering" proved difficult for Adam Becket. He had a rich social life when he lived in London in his early 20s - but after moving to Bristol, he had to make friends from scratch.

"Not only did I not know anyone, I didn't know where to start meeting people either. You can't just go up to someone and be like, 'Can I join in this fun?' It's easy to spiral into self-doubt and self-flagellation - 'I'm clearly not interesting or cool, or the right kind of person.'"

Things improved when he joined running and cycling clubs and met people that he "clicked with" - though he says his loneliness still comes and goes.

Today, there is also a set of new, distinctly modern factors that could be making the problem worse.

In many parts of the world, people are getting married and having children later (or not at all).

The average age of first marriage in the UK is now 31, according to the ONS, up from 1970 when it was 23 for men and 21 for women. Young adults tend to be more reliant on friends for emotional connection - and if those friends don't deliver, loneliness can follow.

Prof Weissbourd points to a broader fragmenting of communities too. In rich countries, membership of civic institutions - like churches, community groups, or trade unions - has dropped since the 1970s.

This is sometimes known as the Bowling Alone thesis, named after an influential 1995 essay by political scientist Robert Putnam, who observed that more young Americans were bowling on their own rather than in teams, a symbol of a wider collapse of social relations.

Twenty-somethings - who might have left their childhood home but not yet started their own family - can feel that decline of community most sharply, says Prof Weissbourd.

"We live in an increasingly individualistic society. I think loneliness is a symptom of our failure to care for each other."

This resonates with Zeyneb, 23, who lives alone in Cheltenham. Her own feelings of loneliness peaked last year during her master's degree. With only a few hours of teaching each week, she struggled to find meaningful connections with her classmates. And with her family far away in Romania, she now spends much of her time alone while she looks for a job.

"It does feel cripplingly lonely when everyone has their own thing to do."

She craves what psychologists call a "third place": a social setting like a park or library that is different from your "first place" (home) or your "second place" (work or university). "We don't really have that space to meet people," she says.

The closest thing she can think of is her gym - but virtually everyone there wears headphones, she tells me, and few make eye contact.

Then there is the post-pandemic rise in working from home. Though young adults in the UK don't work from home as often as older generations - 28% of 16-to-29-year-olds worked from home at least some of the time in the first quarter of 2025, compared with 54% of 30-to-49-year-olds, one study suggests - remote work can hit people in their 20s particularly hard.

"Work from home has been, in my opinion, a nightmare for twenty-somethings," says Dr Jay. "It's really hard to make friends when you don't leave the house."

Nor do shared living situations always help. There is something of a paradox here, as young adults are the most likely to live with other people. (In England and Wales only 5% of people in their early 20s live alone, versus 49% of over-85s, suggests the ONS.) But living under the same roof as others doesn't always seem to make young adults any less lonely.

'I spent 30 years searching for secret to happiness - the answer isn't what I thought'

What screen time does to children's brains is more complicated than it seems

How a 'fertility gap' is fuelling the rise of one-child families

"Some of my most pitiful memories of my 20s were being stuck living with people that I didn't like," recalls Dr Jay. "If I was having a hard time, they didn't care, they were too wrapped up in themselves."

Of course this isn't the case for all house-shares - but she thinks having an emotionally distant flatmate can make people "even more lonely" than if they lived alone.

All of this is complicated by smartphones and social media. This year, the average British 18-to-24-year-old spent six hours and 20 minutes online every day, according to the media regulator Ofcom, higher than other adult age groups.

Some might assume that apps like Instagram and Snapchat contribute to feelings of loneliness because they encourage people to speak online rather than in person - but the data doesn't cleanly support this.

What is certainly true, say some experts, is that social media amplifies pre-existing feelings of loneliness because of what Dr Jay calls the "compare and despair" factor.

"You feel like, 'Everybody seems to have best friends and they're all skydiving in Dubai - what's wrong with me, I didn't see anyone all weekend.'"

Yet it is also possible that reporting biases are playing a role.

Studies about loneliness are mostly based on self-report surveys (meaning people are simply asked whether they feel lonely). And Prof Weissbourd says it is plausible that young adults, who tend to be more fluent in the language of mental health and therapy, are more likely than older people to describe themselves as lonely in surveys.

He thinks reporting biases may explain a "piece" of the puzzle - but certainly not all of it.

Prof Wigfield also thinks the high level of young-adult loneliness is a real phenomenon, not a statistical mirage.

At first, David Gradon's story was fairly typical. In his late 20s, his friends moved away from London. "My social circle really shrunk," he remembers - and he developed symptoms of depression. It was an NHS counsellor who suggested this could be loneliness.

He tried meeting people over dating apps (a "terrible" idea) and joined a tag rugby club, but injured his leg in the first session. Increasingly despondent, he organised a park walk on social media.

One autumn day in 2021, Mr Gradon and 11 strangers met at Hampstead Heath in north London. He organised more walks and other events and in time this became his full-time job. He now runs The Great Friendship Project, a non-profit organisation to combat young adult loneliness, which runs social events for people in their 20s and 30s across London.

"Everyone's in that same boat. And actually, that brings down barriers. Because you know you're not going to be judged," he explains.

His group also carries out research and awareness campaigns about loneliness.

Council-funded youth clubs operate around the country. Most are currently aimed at teenagers and children, but Laura Cunliffe-Hall, head of policy at charity UK Youth, wants to see more clubs for people in their early 20s. She argues that youth work should serve everyone up to the age of 25.

Funding, she says, is the barrier. Local authority spending on youth services in England fell by 73% between 2010/11 and 2023/24, according to the charity YMCA.

Some argue that spending money on friendship services can save money over the long term, because the health consequences of long-term loneliness can be severe. Prof Wigfield says that chronic loneliness is linked to inflammation, and can increase the risk of cardiovascular disease and dementia in later life.

In recent years the NHS has invested in "social prescribing", where GPs connect patients with certain mental health problems to charity-run services in their area - like art classes or gardening.

More than one million people (of all ages) were referred to NHS social prescribing services in 2023, a recent study found.

But Prof Wigfield says infrastructure remains patchy. "It really is a lottery in terms of where you live [and] whether the GP has knowledge of local services."

Looking ahead to the next decade, Dr Jay sees signs of hope. For one, she thinks working from home has "lost some of its lustre" among twenty-somethings. (Several large employers - including Barclays and WPP - asked staff to spend longer in the office this year.)

Dr Jay also notes that some high-profile people are turning against social media - though she says there is not yet much evidence of a significant fall in usage among young adults.

"I'd love to see more of a backlash against [social media], but it's just so in our pockets," she adds.

Then there are those who find their solution to loneliness in unexpected places. For Zeyneb, the best antidote to social isolation was adopting a black cat, Olive.

"She's quite cuddly," says Zeyneb. "She knows when I need time with her.

"Without her, I would have been much lonelier."

articles.title: Advogado do ES usa procuração de mulher morta em NY e saca R$ 151 mil | G1
articles.standfirst: Dinheiro era de um precatório obtido pela mulher em uma ação contra o INSS. Ela morreu em julho de 2022, mas o valor foi retirado em maio de 2024 com uma procuração emitida quase um ano depois da morte.
articles.summary: Dinheiro era de um precatório obtido pela mulher em uma ação contra o INSS. Ela morreu em julho de 2022, mas o valor foi retirado em maio de 2024.
articles.body:
Caixa Econômica Federal — Foto: Caixa Econômica Federal/Divulgação

Um advogado retirou R$ 151,4 mil de uma conta judicial em nome de uma mulher que já havia morrido. O saque foi realizado em uma agência da Caixa Econômica Federal, em Vila Velha, na Grande Vitória, com uma procuração assinada quase um ano depois da morte da beneficiária, que faleceu em Nova York, nos Estados Unidos.

O dinheiro era de um precatório que Marcia Rosa Biasutti Silva tinha a receber após vencer uma ação contra o Instituto Nacional do Seguro Social (INSS). Ela morreu em 5 de julho de 2022, mas o advogado Paulo Sérgio dos Santos Lopes conseguiu retirar R$ 151.477,32 em 28 de maio de 2024.

A procuração apresentada por ele tinha data de 8 de junho de 2023. Ou seja, foi emitida quando Marcia já estava morta havia quase um ano.

O caso veio à tona quando o viúvo de Marcia, responsável pelo inventário, procurou a Justiça Federal para solicitar a liberação do precatório. Durante a análise do pedido, foi informado de que o dinheiro já havia sido sacado.

A 1ª Vara Federal Cível de Vitória considerou inválida a procuração utilizada na operação e determinou o encaminhamento do caso ao Ministério Público Federal (MPF) e à Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil no Espírito Santo (OAB-ES), para análise de possíveis irregularidades.

A decisão foi proferida em 9 de setembro deste ano. O juízo também reconheceu o direito do viúvo e do filho da beneficiária aos valores do precatório. Como o dinheiro já havia sido retirado, eventuais responsabilidades criminais e civis deverão ser apuradas em procedimentos próprios.

A decisão não representa uma condenação criminal dos advogados envolvidos.

Em manifestação apresentada à Justiça, Paulo Sérgio afirmou que agiu de boa-fé e disse que desconhecia a morte da beneficiária.

Segundo ele, um outro advogado, o colega Freddy Francis Rangel Mariano, o procurou, se apresentou como representante de Marcia e entregou a procuração para que realizasse o saque do precatório.

Paulo Sérgio declarou que, antes da retirada, consultou a situação do CPF da mulher na Receita Federal, em maio de 2024, e verificou que o documento constava como regular.

Ainda segundo a manifestação, ele ficou com 10% do valor, a título de honorários, e transferiu R$ 136,3 mil para Freddy em 30 de maio de 2024. O advogado apresentou recibos e documentos de prestação de contas para sustentar sua versão.

O advogado Freddy Francis Rangel Mariano, de 47 anos, foi encontrado morto em Guarapari, Espírito Santo — Foto: Reprodução/Rede social

A investigação esbarrou no fato de que Freddy Francis foi assassinado em maio deste ano, em Guarapari, no litoral do Espírito Santo. O corpo do advogado, de 47 anos, foi encontrado no dia 18 daquele mês, na localidade de Jaboticaba, com marcas de tiros e um corte no pescoço. Um cliente e a esposa foram presos suspeitos do crime.

Até o momento, não há indicação de relação entre o assassinato e as suspeitas de irregularidades no saque do precatório.

Na decisão, a Justiça Federal destacou que o desconhecimento da morte da beneficiária e a alegação de repasse do dinheiro a outro advogado não tornam legítima a retirada.

Segundo o juízo, Paulo Sérgio tinha o dever de verificar se o profissional que lhe entregou a procuração possuía autorização válida para representar Marcia.

Advogada da ação original diz não conhecer os profissionais

A advogada Geane Miller Manchesther, que representou Marcia na ação contra o INSS, afirmou em manifestação apresentada à Justiça que não conhece Paulo Sérgio nem Freddy e que nunca manteve qualquer vínculo pessoal ou profissional com os dois.

Ela apontou indícios de fraude na procuração e pediu a apuração da responsabilidade dos advogados envolvidos, além de questionar a atuação da Caixa Econômica Federal na conferência dos documentos apresentados para liberar o dinheiro.

Geane também esclareceu que o precatório havia sido requisitado em fevereiro de 2022, cinco meses antes da morte de Marcia. Segundo ela, os procedimentos realizados antes do falecimento eram regulares.

A advogada afirmou que só tomou conhecimento da morte quando os valores foram disponibilizados para pagamento. Também relatou que não houve comunicação anterior da família nem atualização automática dessa informação no processo.

Justiça Federal — Foto: Ricardo Medeios/Rede Gazeta

A advogada Victória Colen de La Fuent, que representa o espólio de Marcia, informou que os herdeiros sabiam da existência do precatório, mas desconheciam que o dinheiro já havia sido pago.

Segundo ela, a Justiça Federal reconheceu a invalidade da procuração utilizada para o saque. A defesa aguarda o andamento das apurações e os esclarecimentos sobre o destino dos valores.

A intenção, conforme Victória, é adotar as medidas judiciais cabíveis para identificar os responsáveis e buscar o ressarcimento do dinheiro.

A Justiça Federal determinou o encaminhamento do caso ao Ministério Público Federal, para análise de possíveis crimes, e à OAB-ES, para apuração de eventuais infrações disciplinares.

Em nota, o MPF informou que, apesar de o processo tramitar no Espírito Santo, não há procuradores do órgão no estado atuando no caso.

A OAB-ES informou que não disponibiliza consulta sobre a existência de eventual procedimento disciplinar.

A Caixa Econômica Federal foi procurada para esclarecer as circunstâncias do saque e informar se houve apuração interna sobre a operação, mas não houve retorno até a publicação da reportagem.

articles.title: Vendaval derruba parte do teto de escola, danifica casas e arrasta embarcações no MA; VÍDEO | G1
articles.standfirst: Ventos fortes atingiram Conceição do Lago-Açu na tarde de segunda-feira (9). Parte do teto de uma escola caiu durante as aulas, e embarcações de pescadores foram danificadas.
articles.summary: Ventos fortes atingiram Conceição do Lago-Açu na tarde de segunda-feira (9). Parte do teto de uma escola caiu durante as aulas, e embarcações de pescadores foram danificadas.
articles.body:
Um vendaval atingiu o município de Conceição do Lago-Açu, a 318 km de São Luís , na tarde de segunda-feira (9), e causou danos a embarcações de pescadores, casas, igrejas e prédios. Os ventos fortes começaram por volta das 16h e duraram cerca de 30 minutos .

Parte do teto de uma escola caiu enquanto os alunos estavam em aula. Vídeos gravados por moradores mostram os estragos causados pelo vendaval ( veja acima ). Com a força do vento, embarcações de pescadores foram danificadas e arremessadas a centenas de metros de onde estavam.

Vendaval destelha escola, danifica casas e arrasta embarcações no MA — Foto: Reprodução

Casas e igrejas também sofreram danos. Em um dos imóveis atingidos, partes da estrutura foram arrancadas e lançadas na rua.

Segundo moradores, o vendaval atingiu apenas alguns pontos da cidade. Em nota publicada nas redes sociais, a prefeita de Conceição do Lago-Açu, Professora Cici, manifestou solidariedade às famílias e afirmou que acompanha a situação.

A prefeita não informou quais medidas serão adotadas para atender os moradores atingidos. Leia a nota na íntegra .

"Meus amigos e minhas amigas de Conceição do Lago-Açu, quero manifestar minha solidariedade a todos os trabalhadores e famílias atingidos pela forte ventania registrada na tarde desta segunda-feira, que deixou prejuízos e trouxe transtornos para nossa população.

Sei que, por trás de cada prejuízo, existe uma família, um trabalhador e uma história. Neste momento, quero deixar meu abraço e minha solidariedade a todos que foram afetados.

Estamos atentos à situação e esperamos que, com a união e a força do nosso povo, todos possam superar esse momento.

Que Deus proteja nossas famílias e nossa gente!"

articles.title: Caraguatatuba amplia acesso à saúde com atendimentos em diferentes regiões | G1
articles.standfirst: Município conta com três UPAs, unidades básicas de saúde, distribuição de medicamentos e serviços especializados para atender à população
articles.summary: Município conta com três UPAs, unidades básicas de saúde, distribuição de medicamentos e serviços especializados para atender à população
articles.body:
A saúde pública de Caraguatatuba conta com uma estrutura que reúne atendimento de urgência e emergência, consultas, vacinação, distribuição de medicamentos e acompanhamento especializado. O trabalho envolve profissionais de diferentes áreas e serviços destinados a atender às necessidades da população.

As três Unidades de Pronto Atendimento (UPAs) integram a rede de urgência e emergência, enquanto as Unidades Básicas de Saúde (UBSs) atuam na prevenção de doenças, no acompanhamento de pacientes e na promoção da saúde.

A assistência farmacêutica também tem papel importante nesse atendimento, com a distribuição de milhões de unidades de medicamentos à população. O município mantém ainda serviços especializados em saúde da mulher, saúde bucal e saúde mental, além do Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu).

A qualificação dos profissionais e a ampliação das ações preventivas fazem parte do trabalho da administração municipal para fortalecer a rede pública e garantir que os moradores tenham acesso aos cuidados de saúde em diferentes fases da vida.

Prefeitura de Caraguatatuba. Cuidar das pessoas é prioridade.

articles.title: Escolha o Coop: milhões unidos por um cooperativismo mais justo e sustentável | G1
articles.standfirst: Cooperativismo fortalece economia, gera oportunidades e transforma comunidades em todo o Brasil
articles.summary: Cooperativismo fortalece economia, gera oportunidades e transforma comunidades em todo o Brasil
articles.body:
Cooperativismo fortalece economia, gera oportunidades e transforma comunidades em todo o Brasil — Foto: Acervo

Em um mundo que exige soluções cada vez mais rápidas para desafios econômicos, sociais e ambientais, o cooperativismo surge como uma alternativa capaz de unir desenvolvimento, inclusão e prosperidade compartilhada. Baseado na união de pessoas com objetivos comuns, o modelo cooperativista demonstra que cooperar pode ser mais eficiente do que competir.

Diferentemente das empresas tradicionais, as cooperativas são organizações em que os associados participam ativamente das decisões e dos resultados do negócio. Nesse modelo, todos têm voz, voto e a oportunidade de contribuir para a construção de soluções coletivas que beneficiam não apenas os cooperados, mas também toda a comunidade ao redor.

Presente em todos os setores da economia, o cooperativismo faz parte do cotidiano dos brasileiros. Cooperativas atuam em áreas como saúde, crédito, agropecuária, transporte, consumo, educação, infraestrutura, trabalho, produção de alimentos e serviços, conectando pessoas e promovendo desenvolvimento em regiões urbanas e rurais.

"Escolher o coop" significa apoiar um modelo econômico comprometido com a geração de trabalho e renda, o fortalecimento das economias locais e o desenvolvimento sustentável. Ao adquirir produtos e serviços de cooperativas, consumidores contribuem diretamente para negócios que priorizam pessoas, meio ambiente e impacto social positivo.

Movimento presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros

Atualmente, mais de 18 milhões de brasileiros participam do sistema cooperativista. São professores, médicos, motoristas, agricultores, catadores, empreendedores e consumidores que compartilham o propósito de construir uma sociedade mais próspera e justa. O cooperativismo brasileiro reúne cerca de 4.880 cooperativas, responsáveis pela geração de mais de 493 mil empregos e pela contribuição de mais de R$ 17 bilhões em tributos para os cofres públicos. Os números demonstram a relevância econômica e social de um setor que segue em expansão em todo o país.

Enquanto empresas tradicionais costumam concentrar decisões e resultados, as cooperativas adotam uma gestão participativa, com distribuição dos benefícios entre os associados e forte compromisso com o desenvolvimento social.

Entre os principais diferenciais do modelo cooperativista estão:

Distribuição dos resultados entre os cooperados;

Geração de impacto socioeconômico nas comunidades;

Envolvimento dos produtores e associados nas decisões;

Promoção de trabalho digno e desenvolvimento local;

O cooperativismo cria um ciclo positivo de desenvolvimento que começa nas pessoas e alcança toda a sociedade.

Um exemplo é o de uma cooperativa formada por artesãs. Ao se unirem para produzir e comercializar seus produtos, elas ampliam sua capacidade produtiva, conquistam novos mercados e aumentam sua renda. O crescimento da atividade gera novas oportunidades de trabalho, fortalece o comércio local, movimenta a economia e amplia os investimentos em ações socioambientais.

Como resultado, toda a comunidade se beneficia por meio da geração de emprego, melhoria da qualidade de vida e fortalecimento do desenvolvimento sustentável.

Cooperativismo e sustentabilidade caminham juntos

O compromisso com a sustentabilidade faz parte da essência do cooperativismo. Alinhadas aos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (ODS) da Organização das Nações Unidas (ONU), as cooperativas atuam para promover crescimento econômico responsável, inclusão social e preservação ambiental.

Ao priorizar pessoas e comunidades, o setor contribui para a construção de um modelo econômico mais equilibrado, resiliente e preparado para os desafios do futuro.

Carimbo SomosCoop ajuda consumidores a identificar cooperativas

Para facilitar a identificação de produtos e serviços cooperativistas, o Sistema OCB utiliza o carimbo SomosCoop. Presente em embalagens, campanhas e comunicações institucionais, o selo indica que aquele produto ou serviço foi desenvolvido por uma cooperativa comprometida com o desenvolvimento sustentável, a responsabilidade social e a valorização das pessoas.

Ao optar por produtos com o carimbo SomosCoop, consumidores fortalecem iniciativas que promovem inclusão, geração de renda e desenvolvimento das comunidades brasileiras.

Os dados mais recentes do Anuário do Cooperativismo Brasileiro (divulgados pelo Sistema OCB/GO) mostram os principais números do setor em Goiás:

Cooperativas: 289 coops com registros ativos no Estado.

Cooperados: 710.307 associados (crescimento de 6,59% em relação ao ano anterior, que registrou 666.400).

Faturamento (ingressos): R$ 36,90 bilhões (alta de 18,02% em comparação ao período anterior, com acréscimo de R$ 5,63 bilhões).

Ativos totais: R$ 78,39 bilhões (crescimento de 11,03%).

Empregos diretos: 18.859 postos de trabalho gerados pelas cooperativas

O Sistema OCB/GO estabeleceu como meta para 2027 alcançar R$ 50 bilhões em faturamento e 1 milhão de cooperados

articles.title: EUA retiram aviões de base no Reino Unido após ameaça do Irã, diz jornal | G1
articles.standfirst: Cinco homens foram presos em setembro após incidente em outra base usada por bombardeiros americanos em ataques contra o Irã; outros dois foram detidos depois.
articles.summary: Cinco homens foram presos em setembro após incidente em outra base usada por bombardeiros americanos em ataques contra o Irã; outros dois foram detidos depois.
articles.body:
Os militares dos Estados Unidos retiraram aeronaves de uma segunda base aérea no Reino Unido nesta segunda-feira (10) após uma ameaça do Irã, informou o Wall Street Journal, citando pessoas familiarizadas com o assunto. A movimentação ocorreu semanas depois de os EUA retirarem seus bombardeiros da base aérea RAF Fairford devido a um incidente de segurança supostamente ligado ao Irã.

Dois aviões-tanque de reabastecimento dos EUA que utilizavam a base militar RAF Mildenhall foram deslocados para a Alemanha no início da segunda-feira, enquanto vários outros aviões-tanque que estavam na base foram transferidos para a Alemanha e outros locais mais tarde naquele dia, segundo o WSJ.

De acordo com o jornal, a natureza exata da ameaça à RAF Mildenhall ainda está sendo discutida por autoridades americanas.

“Não comentamos rotineiramente as atividades de outras nações. Aeronaves e outros equipamentos são movimentados regularmente de acordo com as necessidades operacionais”, afirmou um porta-voz do Ministério da Defesa britânico.

O Pentágono e o Comando Europeu dos Estados Unidos não responderam imediatamente a um pedido de comentário da Reuters enviado fora do horário comercial.

Cinco homens foram presos do lado de fora da base aérea RAF Fairford, no sudoeste da Inglaterra, em setembro, devido a um incidente de segurança. Outros dois foram detidos posteriormente sob suspeita de ajudar a inteligência iraniana.

As circunstâncias do incidente, que continuam em grande parte sem explicação, atraíram enorme atenção internacional. O caso ocorreu em um momento de crescente preocupação com as consequências para a segurança dos países ocidentais da guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irã e levou os EUA a retirarem seus bombardeiros B-1 da base de Fairford por razões de segurança.

A RAF Fairford havia sido usada por bombardeiros americanos para realizar ataques contra o Irã.

O primeiro-ministro britânico, Andy Burnham, afirmou no mês passado que as atividades na RAF Fairford provavelmente haviam sido coordenadas no Irã, o que foi negado pelo embaixador de Teerã no Reino Unido.

articles.title: Alagamentos e previsão de granizo: mais de 80 cidades da Bahia estão com alerta de chuvas e tempestade | G1
articles.standfirst: Cidades do interior do estado já registraram alagamentos, destelhamento e queda de energia na terça-feira (9). Previsão é de chuva no estado nos próximos dias.
articles.summary: Cidades do interior do estado já registraram alagamentos, destelhamento e queda de energia na terça-feira (9). Previsão é de chuva no estado nos próximos dias.
articles.body:
O Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia (INMET) emitiu um alerta amarelo de acumulado de chuva para 71 municípios e outro de tempestade para 15 cidades da Bahia. Os avisos abrangem localidades das regiões Metropolitana de Salvador , Sul Baiano e Centro-Sul Baiano, além do Oeste do estado.

O aviso de acumulado de chuvas tem validade até a quinta-feira (12). O litoral sul concentra a maior preocupação, mas Salvador, a Região Metropolitana e o Recôncavo também estão na rota da instabilidade.

Os avisos meteorológicos apontam riscos de alagamentos, queda de galhos e deslizamentos de terra.

Ventania e chuva intensa causa estragos no interior da Bahia — Foto: Redes Sociais

O Inmet também publicou, na noite de terça-feira (9), um aviso de tempestade com chuva até 50 mm/dia, ventos de até 60 km/h e queda de granizo no sul do estado.

Já no oeste, o risco é de tempestade. O aviso meteorológico foi publicado na madrugada desta teça e tem validade até o fim do dia, com previsão é de chuvas de até 50 mm/dia e ventos de até 60 km/h.

Nos dois casos, o risco de corte de energia elétrica é baixo, mas pode haver estragos em plantações, queda de galhos de árvores e alagamentos.

Na tarde da segunda-feira (9), cidades do interior da Bahia foram tomadas por chuvas e intensa ventania causando ruas alagadas, casas e estabelecimentos comerciais destelhados e falta de energia elétrica. Nenhum morador ficou ferido.

Em Guanambi , no sudoeste da Bahia, os ventos chegaram a 76 km/h e estabelecimentos tiveram seus telhados destruídos. Os moradores ficaram sem acesso a energia elétrica na região e o volume de chuva atingiu 12 mm.

No norte do estado, em Remanso , os estragos do temporal provocaram alagamentos e prejuízos em comércios e estabelecimentos, como o fórum municipal e escolas, com o destelhamento e queda de muros.

⚠️ Veja as cidades com alerta de tempestade:

☔ Veja a previsão do tempo para os próximos dias

A chuva deve continuar e ganhar força no litoral, com céu nublado ou parcialmente nublado. Também há previsão de precipitações em Salvador, na Região Metropolitana e no Recôncavo. No Oeste e no Sudoeste, podem ocorrer pancadas de chuva.

No sul da Bahia, nas regiões de Porto Seguro (BA), Canavieiras (BA), Belmonte (BA) e Caravelas (BA), ocorrem pancadas de chuva com trovoadas isoladas. Nessas áreas, está vigente um aviso amarelo de perigo potencial para grandes acumulados de chuva.

A previsão indica chuva no litoral, principalmente no trecho sul. Em Salvador, na Região Metropolitana e no Recôncavo, podem ocorrer períodos de chuva intercalados com momentos de tempo seco. No Oeste, também há possibilidade de pancadas ao longo do dia.

⚠️ Veja os cuidados durante as chuvas e os ventos fortes

O Inema orienta que moradores das regiões incluídas no aviso fiquem atentos às condições do tempo e adotem medidas de segurança durante as tempestades.

Evitar ficar embaixo de árvores durante ventos fortes, devido ao risco de queda de galhos e descargas elétricas;

Não estacionar veículos próximos a torres de transmissão de energia e placas de propaganda;

Evitar utilizar aparelhos eletrônicos ligados à tomada durante tempestades;

Ter cuidado ao navegar ou realizar atividades na água em áreas próximas ao mar.

Em caso de necessidade, a população pode acionar a Defesa Civil pelo telefone 199 ou o Corpo de Bombeiros pelo número 193.

articles.title: Pesca proibida no Amapá: veja as 22 espécies e regras até 2027 | G1
articles.standfirst: Período de defeso protege a reprodução das espécies em bacias da região. Medida estabelece normas para transporte e venda do pescado; multas por descumprimento podem chegar a R$ 50 mil.
articles.summary: A pesca proibida no Amapá atinge 22 espécies como tambaqui e traíra para garantir o defeso; o transporte e a venda ilegal podem gerar multas de até R$ 50 mil.
articles.body:
A pesca, o transporte e a venda de 22 espécies de peixes estão proibidos no Amapá até o dia 15 de março de 2027. O período de defeso, que começou no domingo (15), visa proteger a fase de reprodução dos peixes nas bacias dos rios Amazonas, Araguari, Flexal, Cassiporé, Cunani, Uaçá e seus afluentes.

A restrição também impede o beneficiamento e a industrialização dessas espécies, conforme previsto pelas portarias do Instituto Brasileiro do Meio Ambiente e dos Recursos Naturais Renováveis (Ibama) e da Secretaria de Estado do Meio Ambiente (Sema).

A pesca de subsistência para consumo próprio continua autorizada para comunidades ribeirinhas, desde que feita com linha de mão, vara ou anzol.

A cota é limitada a 5 quilos por família ao dia, ou a um único exemplar acima desse peso. As regras não se aplicam aos povos indígenas em suas terras originárias. A lista de espécies protegidas inclui:

“O defeso é fundamental para garantir a reprodução dos peixes, preservar a biodiversidade e manter os recursos pesqueiros disponíveis para as próximas gerações”, destaca a secretária de Estado do Meio Ambiente, Taísa Mendonça.

A circulação e a venda dos peixes protegidos só serão permitidas se o produto for vindo de pisciculturas licenciadas ou de regiões com calendário de defeso diferente. Nesses casos, é obrigatório apresentar nota fiscal e comprovante de origem.

Pesca de 22 espécies de peixes fica proibida no Amapá até março de 2027. — Foto: Lidiane Lima/GEA

Para liberar o transporte e o comércio, a Sema emitirá o Documento de Origem do Pescado (DOP), certificado que comprova a procedência legal do produto.

O documento pode ser solicitado presencialmente em dois pontos:

Santana : na Colônia dos Pescadores, na área portuária;

Macapá : na sede da Sema, localizada na Avenida Mendonça Furtado, nº 53.

Comerciantes que já possuem estoques capturados antes do início da proibição têm até a terça-feira (17) para declarar as reservas junto ao órgão ambiental. A declaração é indispensável para liberar a venda do lote acumulado.

Quem descumprir as regras estará sujeito a multas que podem chegar a R$ 50 mil , além da apreensão do pescado e dos equipamentos utilizados na atividade ilegal, conforme prevê o Decreto Estadual nº 0230/2026.

“Vamos intensificar as fiscalizações para coibir a pesca e a comercialização ilegal, verificando a documentação e a origem dos produtos. A colaboração dos pescadores e comerciantes é essencial para o cumprimento das regras”, reforça o coordenador de Fiscalização Ambiental da Sema, capitão Alex Afonso.

As operações de combate à pesca ilegal serão realizadas em conjunto com outros órgãos de fiscalização ao longo de todo o período.

articles.title: Papa Leão XIV na Argentina: os embates entre Milei e Francisco | G1
articles.standfirst: Em visita à América Latina, papa Leão XIV dedica viagem a Francisco, que nunca voltou à Argentina, país natal, como líder da Igreja. Relação dos dois papas com o presidente argentino é marcada por divergências e duras críticas.
articles.summary: Papa Leão XIV inicia visita histórica à Argentina em homenagem a Francisco, reacendendo o debate sobre os ataques de Javier Milei à Igreja e à justiça social.
articles.body:
Papa Francisco, argentino morto em 2025; o também argentino presidente Javier Milei e o papa norte-americano Leão XIV. — Foto: Reuters

A visita oficial do papa Leão XIV à Argentina, que começou no último domingo (8) e vai até quarta-feira (11), tem sido marcada por discursos críticos às políticas do presidente Javier Milei e pela defesa dos direitos das pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade no país.

As divergências entre o líder máximo da Igreja Católica e o governo Milei, no entanto, não são novidade. O papa Francisco, antecessor de Leão XIV e morto em 2025, também criticava as propostas de austeridade do presidente argentino e alertava para seus impactos sobre a população mais pobre.

Em sua primeira visita à América Latina como papa, Leão XIV dedicou a viagem a Francisco, que morreu sem conseguir retornar à sua terra natal durante o pontificado.

"Venho com muita alegria cumprir com a viagem que Francisco não pôde", afirmou o atual líder da Igreja Católica.

Em 30 de setembro de 2023, na Cidade do Vaticano, o então papa Francisco com o Robert Francis Prevost, eleito papa — Foto: Getty Images via BBC

Leão e Francisco se unem pelo discurso em prol da caridade. Além disso, as histórias de vida dos dois pontífices também são marcadas pela atuação nas periferias da América Latina.

Jorge Mario Bergolio, nome de batismo de Francisco, nasceu em Buenos Aires e, quando era cardeal, visitava frequentemente as favelas portenhas até se mudar para o Vaticano em 2013.

Já seu sucessor, o norte-americano Robert Francis Prevost, nasceu em Chicago e viveu mais de 20 anos no Peru até ascender ao papado. Chegou ao país como missionário, vivendo regiões periféricas e isoladas até se consolidar em Chiclayo , onde se tornou bispo e, posteriormente, cardeal.

Os discursos de Leão XIV durante a viagem também reforçam a continuidade do legado de seu antecessor. Em solo latino, o pontífice reafirmou o compromisso da Igreja Católica com a caridade, o auxílio aos menos favorecidos e o incentivo à inclusão social.

Na relação delicada entre Francisco e Milei, o presidente argentino chegou a desferir ataques pessoais ao compatriota, algo incomum para um chefe de Estado de um país ocidental contra o líder máximo da Igreja Católica.

Entre xingamentos e duras críticas, o presidente argentino chegou a classificar Francisco como “representante do maligno na Terra” em mais de uma oportunidade.

Relembre, abaixo, os principais episódios de divergência e de reaproximação entre o pontífice argentino e o atual presidente do país.

De 'maligno na Terra' a acusações de comunismo

A relação entre Javier Milei e o Papa Francisco começou de forma abertamente hostil durante a ascensão do líder libertário na política argentina.

Em 2023, enquanto disputava a presidência, Milei fez sucessivos ataques verbais ao pontífice, que defendia publicamente políticas de justiça social, especialmente em seu país natal.

A reação veio após o então papa, sem citar Milei, dizer que se preocupava com "o triufo do egoísmo sobre o comunitarismo" durante a eleição no país.

Milei referiu-se a Francisco como "o maligno na Terra que ocupa o trono da casa de Deus", além de chamá-lo de "imbecil", "nefasto" e de acusá-lo repetidamente de "promover o comunismo" e de exercer "interferência política". O presidente, então candidato, ainda recorreu a xingamentos de baixo calão, como "filho da puta".

A reação da comunidade católica argentina foi imediata. Em setembro de 2023, sacerdotes que atuam em bairros carentes e favelas de Buenos Aires celebraram uma missa comunitária em "desagravo" às ofensas de Milei contra o líder da Igreja.

Após a vitória de Milei, em 2023, os dois conversaram por telefone por cerca de oito minutos . Na conversa, os dois discutiram os índices de pobreza na Argentina e os planos do novo governo para a área social.

Na ocasião, Francisco deu parabéns a Milei pelo triunfo eleitoral, e o presidente eleito aproveitou a ligação para formalizar o primeiro convite para que o papa visitasse a Argentina — viagem que nunca aconteceu.

O encontro na Basílica de São Pedro e o abraço no Vaticano

O momento mais simbólico da reaproximação pública entre o presidente argentino e o chefe da Igreja Católica ocorreu em fevereiro de 2024, na Basílica de São Pedro, durante a cerimônia de canonização de María Antonia de Paz y Figueroa, a "Mama Antula", primeira santa argentina .

Sentado na primeira fila do evento, Milei cumprimentou Francisco publicamente ao fim da celebração. O encontro teve um clima descontraído, transmitido ao vivo por redes de televisão. Os dois chegaram a brincar com o corte de cabelo do presidente argentino.

No dia seguinte, Francisco recebeu Milei para uma audiência privada de mais de uma hora no Vaticano. Antes da reunião, o presidente reiterou o convite para a viagem do pontífice à sua terra natal.

Em uma carta formal, o presidente disse que a visita traria "frutos de pacificação e fraternidade para todos os argentinos superar divisões e confrontos".

A correspondência foi interpretada por diplomatas como um pedido público de desculpas pelas ofensas de campanha.

O presidente da Argentina, Javier Milei, encontra-se com o Papa Francisco no Vaticano em 11 de fevereiro de 2024. — Foto: Reuters

Com a morte de Francisco em 2025, Milei prestou sua homenagem ao compatriota nas redes sociais, adotando um tom de respeito institucional e reconciliação.

Em nota oficial de pesar, o presidente argentino escreveu: "Apesar das diferenças que hoje parecem pequenas, ter podido conhecê-lo em sua bondade e sabedoria foi uma verdadeira honra para mim."

Presidente da Argentina, Javier Milei, lamenta a morte do primeiro papa Argentino. — Foto: Reprodução

Milei também participou das cerimônias de despedida de Francisco no Vaticano, em maio de 2025, ao lado de outros chefes de Estado.

Javier Milei chega à missa de papa Francisco — Foto: REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

A passagem de Leão XIV por Buenos Aires cumpre a viagem que Francisco não pôde realizar em vida, retomando as cobranças da Igreja em relação à justiça social em solo latino.

A viagem de 12 dias pela América Latina começou no Uruguai no dia 6 de novembro. No domingo (8), Leão XIV desembarcou na Argentina, onde fica até quarta-feira (11).

A presença de Leão XIV no país marca a primeira visita de um chefe da Igreja Católica em 39 anos — a última havia sido realizada por João Paulo II em abril de 1987.

Na chegada, o pontífice encontrou-se com o presidente do país, oportunidade em que pediu que Milei preserve a democracia e reconheça os limites do poder, e fez as primeiras críticas às medidas de austeridade do argentino.

"A economia deve estar a serviço das pessoas, e não as pessoas a serviço da economia", disse Leão XIV ao chegar em Buenos Aires.

Na segunda (9), o pontífice reuniu uma multidão de mais de 2,5 milhões de fiéis na capital argentina para uma missa campal. Milei estava presente na cerimônia.

Antes, em uma visita a um centro de atendimento a pessoas com deficiência, Leão XIV defendeu a adoção de políticas de caridade e assistência social, em um momento em que o governo argentino promove cortes de gastos em diferentes setores sociais.

Após deixar a Argentina, o pontífice embarcará para o Peru, país em que residiu por cerca de 20 anos. A viagem terminará no dia 17.

articles.title: 'Demonic mentality': Toddler raped inside abandoned building in Goa; minister blames 90% of such crimes on ‘outsiders’
articles.summary: GOA: A three-to-four-year-old child was allegedly raped inside an abandoned building near Lohia Ground in Mapusa on Diwali night, with police yet to trace
articles.body: GOA: A three-to-four-year-old child was allegedly raped inside an abandoned building near Lohia Ground in Mapusa on Diwali night, with police yet to trace the accused.The girl, who belongs to a family of balloon sellers, was found injured and has been shifted to Goa Medical College and Hospital for treatment. Mapusa police detained a couple of suspects by Monday afternoon.Chief minister Pramod Sawant said that it will be ensured the accused is “kept permanently behind bars”.“People with such mentality should not exist in our society. Police will take strict action and ensure that he goes behind bars permanently,” he said.The girl was found by a group of motorcycle pilots stationed at a stand near the abandoned building. Tribal welfare minister Ramesh Tawadkar claimed “90 per cent” of such crimes in the tourist state are committed by “outsiders”. Such crimes should not happen in Goa or anywhere else in the country, he told PTI.Pilots saw accused with child, thought he was family memberMinister Ramesh Tawadkar said, “The person who has committed this crime has a demonic mentality. Goa is a tourist state. People from outside the state come here and 90% of people involved in such cases are those who have come to Goa from outside,” he added. However, he maintained people could not be stopped from coming to Goa to earn their livelihood.Around 8 pm on Diwali night, a group of motorcycle pilots had initially noticed a man holding the crying child’s hand and escorting her towards the area. However, assuming he was a family member, they did not suspect anything amiss. “We are used to balloon sellers roaming around here during the festive season with little children accompanying them. The child was crying, but walking away with him. So we thought he was known to her and the child was just fussing. We felt bad later, thinking we could have prevented it if we had realised his intentions. We were focused on getting customers when we saw him. But one pilot did call out to the man, asking him to take care of the child. Later, a pilot noticed the girl coming out crying from the abandoned building,” said Pundalik Neurekar, a motorcycle pilot and eyewitness.The girl emerged from the building around 1.5 hours later. The pilots initially assumed she was crying because she had been separated from her family. They kept her with them and tried to pacify her.A woman working at a nearby tailoring shop then noticed the child and gave her a cloth to wrap herself in. On noticing blood on her, the pilots realised she may have been sexually assaulted and alerted the police.A Mapusa police team combed the area around 4 am in search of the accused, but the operation yielded no results. A forensic team collected samples from the crime scene on Monday morning.Police have also obtained CCTV footage from shops in Mapusa market and surrounding areas in an effort to identify the accused. “The man was wearing a jacket. articles.title: Usher’s New Look nonprofit has supported more than 50,000 young people, and its 2026 partnership with BET is helping new talent gain experience in the entertainment industry
articles.summary: Usher’s New Look, the national nonprofit organisation advancing economic mobility through entertainment careers, has served more than 50,000 young people
articles.body: Usher’s New Look, the national nonprofit organisation advancing economic mobility through entertainment careers, has served more than 50,000 young people worldwide, and its 2026 partnership with BET and Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Detroit is helping new talent gain hands-on experience in the entertainment industry. Announced in August 2026, the collaboration aims to expand career pathways into the sector for young people and to develop the next generation of entertainment leaders. Its programmes are designed alongside industry leaders and real production environments, and they also span creative, technical and business careers, from content creation to production, branding and entrepreneurship.How Usher’s New Look grew from a 1999 start into a national entertainment workforce platformAccording to Usher’s New Look, the organisation was founded in 1999 by Usher Raymond IV and two co-founders, and has since evolved into a workforce development platform. It runs a structured pipeline model built around access, training, real-world experience and innovation, aiming to give young people the skills, networks and opportunities to succeed in a rapidly evolving global industry. The organisation says it uses culture, creativity and storytelling as entry points, but keeps its focus on outcomes.From Spark Club to the Tour Internship Program, how young people move through the pathwayParticipants begin with Spark Club, which serves ages 14 to 17, and can progress to the Entertainment Industry Club for ages 18 to 24. Usher’s New Look says each experience is part of a larger journey that runs from early exposure to hands-on training inside Spark Lab Studios, then into cohort-based learning and real-world application through the Entertainment Industry Club and the Tour Internship Program. Every cohort ends with a capstone project, so participants leave with tangible work rather than simply a record of attendance. The organisation also lists industry-backed credentials, employer-connected experiences, mentorship and professional networks among the benefits.Four interns from the Entertainment Industry Club joined BET Next Gen during BET Awards WeekAccording to Broadway World, the opportunity officially launched during the 2026 BET Awards, where four interns from the Entertainment Industry Club: Live Touring Edition joined the BET Next Gen cohort. Two of them were taking part in The R&B Tour featuring Usher and Chris Brown when the partnership was announced. Throughout BET Awards Week, the interns worked alongside BET professionals in communications and public relations, social media and digital operations, marketing, production and brand creative. They helped plan and run one of entertainment’s biggest live television events, gaining firsthand experience in cross-functional collaboration, live event production and media operations.Usher, Louis Carr and Shawn Wilson explain why the partnership matters for young talentUsher said access to programmes such as BET Next Gen is about creating opportunities that inspire young professionals to see what is possible, while letting them learn from industry leaders. Louis Carr, President of BET, said the network’s responsibility extends beyond telling stories to helping develop the people who will tell the next generation of stories. He described the partnership as a shared commitment to expand access, cultivate leadership and build a more inclusive pipeline of future industry leaders. Shawn H. Wilson, President and chief executive of Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Detroit and co-founder of Usher’s New Look, said a true talent pipeline takes intentionality and the right partners, and that the organisations want to keep knocking down barriers.Year-round leadership training in Atlanta and Detroit anchors the next phase of the partnershipThe same report said the organisations planned to turn the initiative into a year-round leadership and workforce development experience anchored within Spark Lab Studios in Atlanta and Detroit, adding hands-on learning, industry certifications and real-world skill development to career exposure. Participants would gain dedicated spaces to train, create and deliver projects, with executive mentorship and ongoing professional development. articles.summary: US President Donald Trump's approval rating remained close to the lowest level of his political career, with growing concerns over the cost of living
articles.body: US President Donald Trump's approval rating remained close to the lowest level of his political career, with growing concerns over the cost of living weighing on his standing after the Republican Party's losses in last week's midterm elections.According to a Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted online across the US from November 6 to 9, 32 per cent of Americans approved of Trump's performance as president. The figure was unchanged from two previous Reuters/Ipsos polls conducted between late October and early November, and one percentage point above his career-low rating of 31 per cent recorded in mid-October.The poll surveyed 1,705 US adults and had a margin of error of approximately two percentage points.Trump's Republicans suffered losses in both chambers of Congress in the November 3 midterm elections.Although some races remain undecided, Democrats recorded their biggest House of Representatives victory since at least 2008 and flipped Senate seats in traditionally conservative states, including Kansas, South Carolina and Texas.Cost of living weighs on Trump's approvalThe poll found that only 21 per cent of Americans approved of Trump's handling of the cost of living, an issue that has emerged as a major concern for voters, Reuters reported.The war launched by the US President against Iran in February has sharply increased fuel prices and added pressure on household finances, according to the report.Trump's rating on the economy stood at 25 per cent, higher than his approval on the cost of living but well below his rating on immigration.Immigration remains a stronger areaHowever, Trump's approval rating on immigration policy stood at 38 per cent, considerably higher than his ratings on economic issues.Among Republican respondents, 81 per cent backed his approach to immigration, compared with 50 per cent who approved of his handling of the cost of living.Since returning to the White House in January 2025, Trump has significantly expanded deportations of immigrants. articles.title: In 2024, Jeff Bezos paid $87 million for a third mansion on Miami's Billionaire Bunker; he and Lauren Sánchez Bezos transformed the temporary home with exotic gardens, a private gym and a pickleball court
articles.summary: Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sánchez Bezos may eventually move into a sprawling custom-built estate on Florida's exclusive Indian Creek Island, but their plans
articles.body: Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sánchez Bezos may eventually move into a sprawling custom-built estate on Florida's exclusive Indian Creek Island, but their plans for the property have not stopped them from upgrading the house they currently call home. According to the Realtor, the Amazon founder paid $87 million for a third mansion on the island in 2024, adding to two neighbouring properties he had already acquired the previous year. What was expected to serve as temporary accommodation has since become the subject of an extensive renovation. From carefully planted tropical gardens to a private gym and pickleball court, the couple have been making substantial changes while their larger residential project takes shape.Jeff Bezos' three mansions worth $234 million on Billionaire BunkerBezos' property purchases on Indian Creek Island have unfolded over several years. Reportedly, in 2023, he acquired two neighbouring mansions for $68 million and $79 million, respectively. The properties form part of a larger plan to create a substantial private estate for himself and his wife.Before that project could become their permanent home, however, the couple needed somewhere to live. In 2024, Bezos purchased another property on the island for $87 million. The Mediterranean-style mansion, set on approximately 1.84 acres, became their primary residence while plans for the neighbouring properties moved forward.The island, commonly known as Billionaire Bunker, is one of South Florida's most exclusive residential addresses. Its appeal lies partly in its waterfront setting and private surroundings, with a small community of exceptionally wealthy residents. NFL legend Tom Brady and Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner are among the high-profile names associated with the neighbourhood.Bezos and Lauren Sánchez's plans for a mega-mansionThe $87 million property is not the centrepiece of Bezos' long-term plans for Indian Creek. That distinction belongs to the two homes he purchased in 2023. Reports have indicated that the couple intend to demolish both existing structures and replace them with one enormous custom-built mansion. The proposed development would bring the neighbouring plots together as a single residential compound.In the meantime, their third mansion has received considerably more attention than a typical temporary residence might. Rather than simply maintaining the property until the larger estate is ready, Bezos and Sánchez Bezos have undertaken changes affecting both the house and its surrounding grounds.Exotic trees and private gardens reshape the mansion's groundsThe outdoor transformation has been one of the most visible parts of the renovation. Professional arborists have been brought in to introduce a variety of exotic trees across the front and rear gardens. Among the reported additions are Japanese yews and Brazilian Beauty Leafs. Their placement creates a denser landscape around the property, providing additional screening from neighbouring homes and helping establish a more secluded setting.The landscaping goes beyond planting trees around the boundaries. Several statues have also been installed across the grounds, while paved pathways wind through the rear garden. These routes divide the outdoor space into smaller landscaped areas, giving the large property a series of more enclosed garden settings.For a waterfront mansion occupying 1.84 acres, the changes represent a substantial reworking of the available outdoor space. The result is a property where landscaping, privacy and recreational facilities have become major parts of the renovation.A private pickleball court and an expanded poolside dining areaThe couple's improvements also include facilities designed for spending time outdoors. Planning applications reviewed by the Realtor indicate that a private pickleball court has been incorporated into the property. The sport has become a popular recreational activity, particularly among affluent homeowners who have sufficient space to install their own courts. At the Bezos residence, it adds another private sporting facility to the grounds.The swimming pool area has also undergone changes. The paved surface around the pool has been extended, creating room for an outdoor dining arrangement beneath a floral canopy.The mansion's garage has been converted into a private gymSome of the more expensive alterations have taken place away from the gardens. The property's existing garage has been converted into a private fitness facility, changing the way the building's space is used. The work involved removing the original garage door and installing new industrial-strength doors. According to the Realtor, planning details, the replacement doors alone cost upwards of $100,000.The interior of the mansion has also been subject to aesthetic improvements, alongside structural work involving the heating, ventilation and air-conditioning system, plumbing and electrical installations. The planning applications were submitted through a limited liability company associated with Bezos' purchase of the mansion. The company is managed by attorney John C. Sumberg.Bezos' move to Florida brought a different property chapterThe Indian Creek purchases followed Bezos' decision to relocate his primary residence from Washington state to Florida in 2023. At the time, he and Sánchez Bezos indicated that the move would bring him closer to members of his family. Florida also offered a significant financial consideration. A February 2024 report by CNBC estimated that Bezos could avoid at least $610 million in taxes that he might otherwise have owed had he continued living full-time in Washington state.His residential connections to Florida had already extended beyond Indian Creek. In 2022, Bezos purchased two adjacent mansions in Coral Gables for $78 million, creating a home for his parents, Mike and Jackie Bezos. His mother, Jackie, died in August 2025 following a long battle with Lewy Body Dementia. Bezos shared a personal tribute on social media, recalling how she had raised him after becoming a mother at 17 and describing the time he was able to spend with her.Indian Creek is one part of Bezos' extensive property portfolioThe Amazon founder's real estate holdings extend well beyond South Florida. He has retained several properties in Washington state, including a substantial residential estate in Hunts Point, near Seattle. Bezos and his former wife, MacKenzie Scott, initially purchased two homes on a five-acre site in Hunts Point for $10 million, four years after Amazon was founded. The estate was subsequently renovated, with reports placing the cost of the work at approximately $28 million in 2010.The property includes 310 feet of private shoreline and a private boathouse. Bezos later acquired an adjacent 24,000-square-foot mansion, further expanding the estate. His portfolio also includes a Washington, DC, residence purchased for $23 million in 2017, alongside several apartments in a Manhattan building. The New York holdings include a three-storey penthouse and two additional apartments, with building permits filed in 2019 to combine the units.In California, Bezos owns a Beverly Hills mansion purchased from music executive David Geffen for $165 million in 2020. The property has also attracted attention beyond its ownership, serving as the location for Kris Jenner's 70th birthday celebration in 2025. His real estate interests have not remained entirely unchanged. In April 2026, Bezos sold a Seattle-area property for a reported $63 million, having purchased it for $37.5 million in 2019.Disclaimer: This article is based on information publicly available. articles.title: European diplomats press Rubio for a role in Russia-Ukraine talks
articles.summary: G7 foreign ministers are meeting in Paris ahead of the US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi.
articles.body:
European foreign ministers have told United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio that Europe must have a say in any deal to end Russia’s war on Ukraine, as US-mediated peace talks get under way in Abu Dhabi.

They made the appeal on Monday in Paris, at a meeting of foreign ministers from the Group of Seven, which includes Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the United Kingdom and the United States.

It was Rubio’s first meeting with allies since last week’s midterm elections, in which President Donald Trump’s Republican Party suffered stunning losses. The meeting gave Washington’s allies a chance to air their concerns with Rubio directly amid concern about Trump’s growing rhetoric of a new security architecture for Europe.

“It is certainly neither necessary, nor right, nor appropriate to make a fundamental change” to Europe’s security architecture, said German Minister for Foreign Affairs Johann Wadephul after talks with Rubio.

“Europe belongs at this table. There can be no solution without Europe – only with Europe,” he added.

The two-day Paris meeting, which ends on Tuesday, overlaps with the talks between Russia and Ukraine, scheduled for Tuesday and Wednesday.

Wadephul said the Abu Dhabi talks must show whether Russia is “genuinely prepared to negotiate”, urging Moscow to “give up maximalist demands” and warning against any “negotiation show” in the capital of the United Arab Emirates.

With Russian attacks on Ukraine’s civilian infrastructure continuing, he said, “we see no substantial contribution whatsoever toward negotiations gaining any serious momentum” from Moscow.

Andrii Sybiha, Ukraine’s foreign minister, is set to join a session on Ukraine in Paris on Tuesday.

“No one has the right to decide our fate behind our backs,” Sybiha said before departing for the meeting.

The Paris meeting comes as G7 members have grown increasingly uneasy with the direction of US policy, including Washington’s scaling back of support for Ukraine and of sanctions on Russia, as well as its increasingly unilateral course.

Ministers from Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Korea and Brazil are also attending.

Iran is expected to feature prominently in the discussions on Tuesday.

Washington’s G7 allies have repeatedly voiced scepticism about the US and Israeli war on Iran and fear that further US military action could deepen the crisis rather than resolve it.

Al Jazeera’s Rebecca Collard, reporting from Paris, said the first day of talks had wrapped up with little clarity on US policy after the midterm elections.

“The second day of talks will include a session on instability in the Middle East,” she said.

“But there is something bigger up for discussion, too: The future of the multilateralism that has dominated relations among these countries for decades.”

articles.title: Krakow attack: Polish unity on show as thousands join silent march for shooting victims
articles.summary: Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by Saturday's attack, writes Sarah Rainsford.
articles.body:
Thousands of people joined a silent march through central Krakow on Monday night, in memory of those killed and injured when a gunman went on a violent rampage at the weekend.

The crowd were led by Poland's president and prime minister, the bitter political rivals putting on a rare show of unity after the country's deadliest attack in modern times.

As they reached the historic Market Square, a bugler played from the tower.

Many people were carrying flowers or candles to leave at the shrines that now dot the cobblestones, each one marking a spot where someone died.

Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by this attack. It has left people struggling to make some kind of sense of what happened.

The alleged gunman has been named as 24-year-old Michal Oksinski by local media.

Critically injured in a shoot-out with police, he did not regain consciousness and died in hospital early on Monday .

Initially, the interior minister claimed that Oksinski was driven by far-right, extremist views. The national prosecutor's office now says that it is too soon to say he was "inspired" by any ideology.

"The minister wanted to win domestic political points. That's not responsible behaviour," Pawel Musialek of the Jagiellonian University suggests, in a country where politics is highly - and often viciously - polarised.

"So far we've seen no clear message that this guy was strongly ideological, and that it's not more like something from the darknet."

There has been no mention of any letter or manifesto that Oksinski left. One neighbour told Polish news site Onet that the 24-year-old was a "bit of a loner" but few who knew him well have spoken publicly.

What we know so far after Krakow gun attack

In addition to his electronic devices like his phone, investigators are examining a number of badges that Oksinski had attached to his military-style outfit.

The prosecutor's office says a yellow Gadsden flag with a coiled snake symbol was displayed in his bedroom. "It has various meanings of freedom and rebellion," a spokesman emphasised. "Not necessarily negative."

It was at Oksinski's home that the bodies of his parents and sister were discovered.

It is alleged that he shot them, before driving some 200km (125 miles) south to continue the killing in Krakow.

Two days on, shops and cafes around the market square are beginning to fill up again, but the mood is subdued.

A Zara clothes shop is still boarded up, after bullets smashed the glass. A local man in his 50s died just outside.

Jo, a Scottish tourist, saw paramedics "who got there ridiculously fast", fighting to save him. "It was all pretty grim."

Like many, she initially mistook the rifle shots for fireworks.

On the opposite corner of the square, beside another cluster of flowers, people keep pausing to take pictures of the holes that were blasted into the wall by gunfire.

One of the six victims has been identified as a Polish painter in her 50s, who was a mother of four, and in town with friends for an exhibition opening.

A British citizen and an Austrian who died are yet to be named publicly.

Several drivers of the horse-drawn carriages that are usually poised to trot tourists around the square were seriously injured.

Olha, who works in a nearby chocolate shop says everyone is now nervous.

On Saturday, people rushed into her store to escape the gunman who was tearing around in his car, firing through the window.

Olha is Ukrainian, and moved to Krakow when Russia invaded. "We left our own country for safety. This is supposed to be a safe place!" she said.

"It's so sad, and so scary. Especially that he drove all the way here for two hours, planning this and thinking about it."

She regrets that the gunman did not survive: "So many are dead, so many lives have been ruined, and now there will be no justice."

When Oksinski's car was searched, four firearms and "hundreds of rounds of ammunition" were found, all owned legally by the alleged killer and his father.

Both were members of the Swit Starachowice sports club, where there is a shooting range. A spokesman recalls Michal Oksinski as unremarkable: average competition results and normal behaviour.

He had been just three times this year, most recently in August with his father. The club spokesman is adamant that it does not train combat firing, only shooting from a fixed point.

Gun ownership in Poland has grown considerably since war broke out in Ukraine just across the border, but this is the first mass shooting anyone here can remember.

Inevitably, it has brought scrutiny of the checks over who qualifies to handle such weapons, including psychological tests, as Michal Oksinski passed all of them.

On Monday, the government announced an urgent review.

At the spot where Oksinski's car was intercepted and he was shot by police there is another memorial, this one in honour of the officers still in hospital.

Some have brought flowers, but a girl called Bianka has left a card that reads: "Thank you Mr Policemen, get better soon."

A couple of steps away, there's a series of bullet holes in the glass.

"This man was a real hero, he didn't hesitate," Ania says, referring to officer Jakub Kulik who was shot in the chest. His condition remains serious. "We're here to help him fight for his life."

"Nothing like this has never happened before, it's terrible," a young man called Wojtek tells me.

He's only glad that the gunman responsible for such horror turned out to be Polish.

"People here are already against immigration, so that would have been even worse."

Ania thinks Poles will pull through, though the country's image as a low-crime oasis has been shattered.

Most of all, she's angry that Michal Oksinski died without being held to account for the devastation.

articles.title: Firms tied to West Bank settlements win $15m UK deals despite sanctions
articles.summary: Former Labour leader Jeremy Corbyn called the findings ‘outrageous and frankly insulting to the public’.
articles.body:
The United Kingdom awarded 10.7 million pounds ($14.4m) in new public contracts to firms with links to illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, despite British government pledges to punish companies that profit from settlement activity, an Al Jazeera investigation reveals.

The contracts were published after the British government announced new powers on September 8 to sanction companies profiting from business with Israeli settlements in the West Bank, which are illegal under international law.

An analysis of procurement records, company filings, corporate disclosures and contract data supplied by Tussell, a British public sector market intelligence firm, has found that businesses named by the United Nations over their involvement in illegal Israeli settlements – and companies that those businesses ultimately own or control as subsidiaries – have secured contracts across the British public sector.

The companies “appear to be in breach of their legal obligations under international humanitarian law”, Neve Gordon, a professor at the school of law at Queen Mary University of London, told Al Jazeera.

“Any UK company that is involved in the occupation is likely to be in direct breach of the sanctions regime Ed Miliband is putting in place,” Gordon said, referring to the UK foreign secretary.

This follows a previous Al Jazeera investigation in August which revealed at least 17 companies linked to illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank have been awarded UK public-sector contracts worth more than 2.1 billion pounds ($2.85bn).

On September 8, Miliband told the House of Commons the government would now “take action against specific companies and individuals who provide services such as construction, infrastructure, financing or real estate for settlement expansion”.

“To those who finance or facilitate illegal settlements, let me say this: you will face the full force of UK sanctions … Settlements are illegal.”

Since the announcement, however, UK public bodies have published details of an additional 18 public contracts with companies linked to illegal settlements in the occupied West Bank.

Former Labour Party leader and MP Jeremy Corbyn told Al Jazeera: “Britain cannot credibly claim that it is imposing sanctions on Israeli settlements while letting contracts continue through the back door. The fact that public money is still going to firms that could be targeted under the government’s own sanctions regime … is outrageous and frankly insulting to the public.”

Al Jazeera contacted the Cabinet Office for comment about this but received no response. The Cabinet Office previously told Al Jazeera that individual public authorities make decisions to exclude suppliers on a case-by-case basis for each contract they award. It said public procurement in the UK should not be used to boycott suppliers linked to other countries unless formal British sanctions, embargoes or restrictions are in place.

One group that the UN listed in its September 2026 settlement index update for its commercial use of natural resources in the occupied Palestinian territory is Heidelberg Materials, a multinational building materials firm with headquarters in Germany.

Three Heidelberg subsidiaries were named in 14 contracts worth 10.4 million pounds ($14.5m), mostly to undertake roadworks and resurfacing for National Highways and councils in Nottingham and Lincolnshire in central-eastern England. The group has been granted at least 35 UK contracts worth about 194.7 million pounds ($261m) across five of its subsidiaries.

Its Israeli subsidiary, Hanson Israel, owns the Nahal Raba quarry, south of Qalqilya in the West Bank. The quarry sits on land belonging to the Palestinian villages of az-Zawiya and Rafat, according to Who Profits, a group that researches links between the private sector and the economy in the occupied territory. An official Civil Administration Service planning notice reviewed by Al Jazeera shows a proposal was approved to expand the site. According to the company’s website, the firm undertakes “quarrying, grinding and screening of natural dolomite or limestone rock”.

Heidelberg has previously told Al Jazeera that Hanson Israel ceased operations at the quarry and its associated plants in 2023.

But Who Profits said approval for the expansion of the quarry was granted on May 28, 2025. Heidelberg did not dispute the Who Profits assertion in its response to Al Jazeera’s questions.

Two contracts, worth about 87,900 pounds ($118,000), have been awarded to Motorola Solutions and its subsidiaries to provide communications for the police service.

Motorola Solutions still accounts for the largest share by value of the contracts Al Jazeera identified, with about 1.7 billion pounds ($2.28bn), most of it through its UK subsidiary Airwave Solutions.

The Home Office awarded Airwave an extension worth 1.562 billion pounds ($2.13bn) to provide the secure communications network used by police, fire and ambulance services across England, Scotland and Wales. Motorola Solutions UK separately holds contracts worth 123.9 million pounds ($170m), including a 36.5-million-pound ($49.8m) Ministry of Defence contract for Airwave radios, accessories and airtime.

The UN lists Motorola Solutions for its settlement-related activities, including the provision of security equipment and services. Procurement records reviewed by Al Jazeera show Motorola command-and-control technology used in security and surveillance infrastructure by authorities in the occupied West Bank.

Al Jazeera contacted the Motorola Solutions group for comment but received no response.

Chinese conglomerate Fosun International is identified by the UN under the category covering the commercial use of natural resources, particularly water and land.

Its connection to the occupied West Bank centres on Israeli cosmetics manufacturer Ahava Dead Sea Laboratories.

In the UK, Breas Medical, which Fosun International owns through Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical, secured a contract worth 98,000 pounds ($131,000) with Hull hospitals. The award brings the total value of public-sector contracts held by the group to at least 1.3 million pounds ($1.74m).

Al Jazeera contacted Fosun for comment but received no response.

French engineering group Egis provides another type of connection via transport infrastructure linking illegal Israeli settlements in occupied East Jerusalem with the rest of the city.

The UN lists Egis in connection with the “provision of services and utilities supporting the maintenance and existence of settlements, including transport”.

Egis told Al Jazeera it “formally expressed its disagreement with this inclusion” in the UN database.

A new contract worth 84,000 pounds ($113,000) was awarded to Thomas & Adamson International Limited, a subsidiary of Egis. The award brings the total value of public contracts held by Egis and its subsidiaries to at least 133.7 million pounds ($179.3m).
